_notes: Document 'verify' in the agency review queue was 'onayla' (approve); unified on 'doğrula' to match the shared status 'Doğrulandı' and 'Belge doğrulandı' notifications. 'Onayla' stays for enrollment/tuition confirmations in the university console.
Admission letter (표준입학허가서) is 'kabul mektubu' everywhere (was 'kabul belgesi' in one university hint); the official document is named 'standart kabul mektubu' where the English says so.
Admission guide (모집요강) is 'kabul kılavuzu'; the one existing key said 'başvuru kılavuzu' and was aligned with the new HQ keys.
'Waiting on us' is rendered 'Sıra bizde' (our move), which is how a Turkish ops team would say it; 'Öğrenci bekleniyor' etc. keep the 'party being waited on' pattern.
Plan was 'paket' in the workspace tab; unified on 'plan'. Essays tab already said 'Yazılar', so the sidebar was aligned to it (was 'Kompozisyonlar').

University console: Program column/filter said 'Bölüm' (department); unified on 'Program' as the rest of the console uses it. 'Offer rate' is 'teklif oranı' (one key said 'kabul oranı'). Insights nav is 'İçgörüler', so the pipeline label no longer points to 'Analiz'.
Settling in (D-30 to D+30) keeps the D-day notation 'D-30 ile D+30 arası', which Turkish ops staff read without translation.
Formal (siz) register throughout; agency strings are imperative and short, university strings are formal and analytical.
